title: May Allah Send Us a King, Mahdi (a)
body:
Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, astaghfirullah. Please send us a king, Mahdi (a), so we can fight in the way of
Allah (swt).
•••••• •••• ••••• •••••••• •••• ••••• •••••••••••• •••• •••••• •••••• •••• ••••••• •••••••• • •••••• ••••••• ••••• •••••• •
••••••••• ••• ••••••• •••••••
Alam tara ila 'l-mala'i min banee israa'eela min ba`di Musa idh qaaloo li-nabiyyin lahumu ib`ath lanaa
malikan nuqaatil fee sabeelillah. Have you not thought about the group of the Children of Israel after (the
time of) Moses, when they said to a prophet of theirs, "Appoint for us a king and we will fight in Allah's
Way." (al-Baqarah, 2:246)
Yaa Rabbee! Allah, Allah. The enemies of Allah are followers of Shaytan! From east to west, this world has
become filled with the enemies of Allah. They have no loyalty for the prophets of Allah. No, their egos are
working for Shaytan and seven billion of them occupy the Earth. Their egos are never satisfied, always
hungry. They do not work for their Lord. If they worked for Allah with the intention of strengthening their
bodies to serve Allah (swt), they would be satisfied.
••••• •••••••• •••••••• •••••••••• •••••• •••••••••••••

Wa maa khalaqta 'l-jinna wa 'l-ins illa li-ya`budoon. I have only created jinn and men that they may serve
Me. (azh-Zhariyaat, 51:56)
Whatever they plant will be enough for them, but, oh never, as they are tired and exhausted. They earn their
sustenance with difficulty, but if they were to make their intention to Allah with sincerity, they would have
their providence coming to them with ease and in plenitude. They find no taste in their lives and they do not
find satisfaction. Therefore, people are running after every kind of forbidden action, thinking they will find
rest and satisfaction in it. That is inspiration from Shaytan. Never (will they find it on that way)!
Yaa Allah! We are always asking You to send us the Owner of this time, Sayyidina al-Mahdi (a). They have all
the technology, but with his takbir, “Allahu Akbar. Allahu Akbar. Allahu Akbar,” everything will halt and their
power will cease and finish. Allahu Akbar wa lillahi ‘l-hamd. Allahu Akbar wa lillahi ‘l-hamd. Allahu Akbar wa
lillahi ‘l-hamd!
Grandshaykh (q) said, “At the time of Sayyidina Mahdi (a) and at the appearance of the Anti-Christ who will
appear from east to west, the Muslims will gather in Sham. Millions will gather there at the time of
Armageddon. It is the best place for them to be at that time.” At that time, someone will throw their hat in the
sky and it will fall on someone else; to that extent will Damascus be crowded! One of the Sahaabah (r) asked
Rasoolullah (s), “How will people live at that time? Prophet (s) replied, “If one man eats only a mouthful of
food, he will feel as if he has eaten an entire sheep.” That is a karamah, miracle; it is Allah’s generosity. These
are miraculous events with Sayyidina al-Mahdi (a). SubhaanAllah.
O Allah! Grant us the opportunity to stand under the flag of Mahdi (a) in this world and under the flag of
Rasoolullah (s) in the Hereafter, inshaa-Allah, with the barakah of Prophet (s)!
Fatihah.
